title: Point-Class Rank under Quantum Wall Crossing: Local Transport, Global Obstructions, and Cubic Threefolds
description: This paper proves exact Gamma point-row transport identities for a simple VGIT wall and an ordinary flop, and gives countermodels showing why formal monodromy, pairing, integrality, and localized Fourier support do not suffice to compose local comparisons. For a global Wlodarczyk cobordism it proves support collapse and reduces each individual neutral fixed-graph coefficient to a balanced Gamma-ratio kernel. The further complete-neutral continuation of the nonlinear graph sum is isolated as an explicit hypothesis rather than attributed to the available linear GLSM theorem. Under this hypothesis, the point-row primary Boolean is birationally invariant. For a smooth cubic threefold X, the paper reconstructs the primitive-sixth block from Cai's matrices and independently proves point-row nonvanishing by a hypergeometric Barnes calculation; the conditional criterion then distinguishes X × P^m from projective space for every m.
